technical.summary: KMI shows conflicting signals with longer-term EMA/SMA bullish alignment but severe short-term weakness (oversold oscillators, price below all MAs, negative MACD, below Ichimoku cloud) and no momentum confirmation—unsuitable for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: KMI shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 27 days present elevated risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-like 15 score) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; neutral AAII sentiment (61% bearish) suggests capitulation may be incomplete.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (302.6), strong dollar pressures energy multinationals, FOMC event just passed, and earnings in 27 days create compounded uncertainty.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme fear sentiment (contrarian buy signal) combined with longer-term EMA/SMA bullish alignment and price near support (14.2968) creates asymmetric risk/reward for contrarian traders willing to accept macro headwinds.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe short-term technical deterioration (price below all MAs, RSI <40, MACD negative, Ichimoku below cloud, ADX weak at 17.88), compounded by crisis-level macro conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX spike, strong dollar), earnings risk in 27 days, and zero fundamental catalysts make this a high-probability stop-loss trigger.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme fear sentiment and price at support offer contrarian appeal, but severe short-term technical deterioration (price below all MAs, RSI <40, MACD negative, Ichimoku below cloud) combined with crisis-level macro conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX spike) create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings in 27 days combined with inverted yield curve and weak trend strength (ADX 17.88) create compounded uncertainty; stop-loss likely to trigger before mean reversion.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on high risk despite contrarian sentiment opportunity
decision.portfolio_note: Already 7 positions open in Energy sector; adding KMI increases concentration risk without offsetting fundamental or momentum conviction.
